hero.kicker: Simple Process · Fully Managed · No Paperwork for You
hero.headline: Solar Has Never Been This Easy to Get Right
hero.subheadline: From your first free call to switch-on day, SunPath manages every step — design, permits, installation, and rebate processing. You just choose the system you want.
hero.image_alt: SunPath Solar installer team arriving at an Australian home with equipment for installation day

process.step_1_body: We start with your electricity bills and a phone or video chat to understand your energy usage and goals. Then we visit your property to assess roof orientation, shading, structure, and existing switchboard. No cost, no obligation. You'll receive a custom proposal within 48 hours.
process.step_2_body: Our engineers design your solar system — panel layout, inverter selection, tilt angles, and string configuration — optimised for your specific roof and energy pattern. We lodge all council permits and distributor connection applications (DNSP approval). Most approvals are completed within 5–10 business days.
process.step_3_body: Our CEC-accredited installation team arrives on the scheduled day and completes most residential systems in 6–8 hours. We mount racking, install panels and inverter, wire the switchboard, and commission the system. We clean up fully before we leave and walk you through how everything works.
process.step_4_body: We submit your Small-scale Technology Certificate (STC) rebate claim on your behalf — this is typically deducted directly from your system cost. Your network distributor connects you to the grid and activates your feed-in tariff. We set up your monitoring app so you can track generation and savings in real time from your phone.

features.row_1_headline: What If My Roof Is Tricky?
features.row_1_body: No two Australian roofs are identical. Our engineers have designed systems for everything from Victorian terraces to corrugated iron sheds to flat commercial membranes. We use engineering-grade mounting systems rated to Australian wind and cyclone zones.
features.row_1_image_alt: SunPath engineer inspecting a complex multi-pitch roof with an assessment checklist
features.row_2_body: Every SunPath installation includes: 25-year panel performance warranty, 10-year product warranty on panels, 10-year inverter warranty, 10-year SunPath workmanship warranty, and 5-year mounting warranty. All warranties are lodged and tracked in your customer portal.
features.row_2_image_alt: SunPath warranty document and customer portal overview on a laptop screen
features.row_3_body: SunPath's monitoring platform flags performance drops automatically. If a fault is detected, our team contacts you before you notice anything. Most inverter issues are resolved remotely within 24 hours. On-site service visits are scheduled within 5 business days across all service areas.
features.row_3_image_alt: SunPath monitoring dashboard showing live solar generation data on a smartphone

features.row_2_body: Many solar companies disappear after installation. Our support team monitors every system we've ever installed. If we detect a fault, we contact you proactively. Our 10-year workmanship warranty is backed by the company, not a third-party insurer.
